officialEvidence.currentContext: The current Stadtwerke Backnang site documents ongoing e-mobility activity but does not publish a current public charging tariff matrix in the accessible e-mobility content reviewed.
officialEvidence.municipalEvidence: The municipality lists a Stadtwerke Backnang AC Type 2 charging point at the utility location as free during stated opening hours. This is retained as exact station-level evidence only and is not generalized to any wider SWBK public network.

pricingEvidence.reasonNotPromoted: The available exact free-price evidence is tied to one municipal listing/location and does not establish a network-wide ad-hoc policy or cover other Backnang public charging infrastructure.

decision: Keep partial/fail-closed. Preserve the free station only as station-level evidence and do not create a global SWBK fallback.
neededToClose: Identify the current BNetzA EVSE(s) operated by Stadtwerke Backnang and obtain operator-controlled QR/direct-payment pricing or an official tariff sheet defining the scope beyond the single free utility-site charger.
